title: fix: Gemini tool arrays without items no longer fail with 400
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Fixed Gemini tool calls returning a 400 error when a function parameter declares an array without `items`. The Vertex tool-schema sanitizer now adds `items: {}` to those arrays, allowing any item type; OpenAI already accepts that schema. Added a regression test for the missing-`items` case.
